_comment: Texts of the terminal of Unzensiert (scripts\lib\AgentUi*.ps1, AgentLoop.ps1, AgentRepl.ps1), the same for every style. {0}, {1} ... are placeholders; a list of two entries under count means singular and plural. What the model reads stays in the code. Colours, glyphs and the words that belong to a style (activity verbs, done words) are in the section agent of the style file (config\styles\). Description: docs\style.md.

welcome.noRules: no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md – /init writes one
welcome.keys: Enter send · Shift+Enter new line · Esc stop · Shift+Tab rights · /help everything

modes.edits: changes files without asking, commands ask
modes.all: everything without asking – the guard decides first
modes.plan: researches and plans, changes nothing until you approve the plan

permission.title: Allow?
permission.allowedAlways: allowed, also from now on in this session
permission.denied: denied – the model waits for you
permission.webSearch: the search terms go out to the search engine on the internet
permission.webFetch: the address goes out to the internet
permission.planMode: plan mode: the model wants to run this while it plans
permission.outsideSandbox: it would run as you, outside the sandbox: with internet, your files and your credentials
permission.protected: this file runs or is obeyed later by itself (protectedFiles in config\guard.json)
permission.viewFirst: not everything is shown yet: v first

trust.title: Do you trust this folder?
trust.explain: It brings things along that Unzensiert would obey or start. Only say yes if you know where they come from.
trust.check: {0} - check command; you are asked again before it runs for the first time
trust.tooLong: too long to show here ({0}): open it in an editor
trust.unreadable: {0} leads to another computer or cannot be read; it is never used
trust.confirmed: confirmed; a change will ask again
trust.left: nothing of this folder was used
trust.note: this folder is not confirmed: {0} not used. Confirm it once in a terminal, or add --trust for this run.
trust.checkTitle: Run the check command of this project?
trust.checkExplain: The closing check wants to run it now. It starts the tests of the project, so also code the model has just written.
trust.checkSkipped: The check command {0} was not run: not confirmed.

sandbox.failed: The sandbox could not start a command ({0}); it is off for this session, commands run as you again. scripts\Setup-Sandbox.ps1 repairs it.
sandbox.unprotected: The sandbox could not protect the project folder ({0}); it is off for this session, commands run as you again under the usual questions.

why.notSetUp: not set up on this computer (scripts\Setup-Sandbox.ps1)
why.noService: set up before the sandbox had its service: scripts\Setup-Sandbox.ps1 sets it up (one administrator question)

undo.title: Take back the last request?
undo.done: taken back: {0} files as before the request; the model learns it with your next message
undo.failed: not everything could be taken back: {0}
undo.nothing: Nothing to take back in this conversation.
undo.allChanged: The files of the last request were all changed again since ({0}); nothing is taken back.
undo.outside: a link leads out of the project

why.root: a drive, your user folder or a folder of Windows is no project folder
why.network: the folder lies on another computer
why.tooMany: more than {0} new files at once
why.slow: keeping the files took longer than {0} s

question.title: Question
question.multi: several possible: numbers separated by commas, or your own answer
question.numbers: Numbers (such as 1,3) or your own answer
question.stopped: stopped – the model waits for you

plan.title: Plan
plan.approvedEdits: plan approved – the model starts, file changes run without asking
plan.rejected: not approved – the model revises the plan
plan.stopped: stopped – the model waits for you

turn.loop: stopped after {0}: the model was going in circles

notes.intro: Enter send · Shift+Enter new line · Esc stop · /help commands · /exit quit
notes.draft: Your text is in the history: Up arrow brings it back.
notes.serverStarting: llama-server is not running, starting it now …
notes.contextFull: The conversation no longer fits into the context.
notes.noImages: The model takes no images; they are left out.
notes.answerBroke: The answer broke off before its end; asking the model once more.
notes.refused: {0} calls were refused; the request ends.
notes.repeating: The model repeats the same call ({0}); the request ends.
notes.noEffect: The model keeps writing what is already in the files ({0} times); the request ends.
notes.cutOff: The answer was cut off at the limit of {0} tokens.
notes.maxRounds: Stopped after {0} rounds with tools (maxToolRounds in config\unzensiert.json or --max-turns).
notes.shortened: Context: older tool results shortened by {0} characters
notes.noSummary: No summary; the conversation stays as it is.
notes.noEarlier: There is no earlier conversation in this folder.
notes.modelSwitched: Model {0} · {1} tokens of context; it loads with the next request
notes.thinkingShown: The model's thinking is now shown.
notes.thinkingHidden: The model's thinking is now hidden.
notes.noGpus: llama.cpp sees no graphics card; the models run on the processor.
notes.chooseGpus: Numbers such as 1 2, or all (Enter = keep)
notes.unknownGpu: Not a card of the list: {0} – /gpu shows them.
notes.gpusChosen: Cards: {0} · the planner spreads the models over them again (llama-server stops for that; Esc stops) …
notes.gpuPlanFailed: {0} could not be planned (see above); llama.cpp places it on the chosen cards by itself.
notes.gpusStopped: Planning stopped. Models not planned yet are placed by llama.cpp on the chosen cards; /gpu plans again.
notes.gpusPlanned: Done: the models use {0} · {1} has {2} tokens of context; it loads with the next request
notes.todoOpen: Task list: {0} still open – the model goes on
notes.emptyAnswer: The answer was empty – the model is sent back to the task

keys: stop the model, also a running command
switch rights: ask → edits → plan → all
paste an image from the clipboard
run a command yourself; the model sees it with your next message
commands: choose the graphics cards (numbers or all); the planner spreads the models over them
set rights: ask, edits, plan, all
plan mode: research, questions and a plan before any change (after it: the task)
summarise the conversation (after it: what to keep)
continue an earlier conversation of this folder
take back the file changes of the last request (again: the one before)
show or hide the model's thinking
the model writes an AGENTS.md for the project

demo.activity: The activity line while something runs
